name: Be thui Cau Mong
summary: Bê thui Cầu Mống is the second plate VOV2 named at the 24 Mar 2022 night program in Thôn Mỹ Sơn. The note does not describe the meat, the fire, or the dip. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Named by VOV2 at Thôn Mỹ Sơn for the night of 24 Mar 2022. No street is printed.
howToEat: VOV2 lists the name and does not say how the meat is cooked or what it is eaten with. The method is Check on arrival.
The program it describes began at 16:00 on 24 Mar 2022 in Thôn Mỹ Sơn, xã Duy Phú. On 1 Dec 2025 Tuổi Trẻ quotes the deputy in charge saying the night calendar is not fixed.
The price is Check on arrival.
where: VOV2 places that night in Thôn Mỹ Sơn and does not name a stall. The ticket information page forbids eating in the monument area.
The sanctuary essay’s thịt nghé is a different sentence. It does not call that meat bê thui Cầu Mống.
